results.hypothesis: To determine whether Continuous-time Infinite Dynamic Topic Model and Dynamic Probabilistic Topic Modeling can detect emerging interdisciplinary research areas earlier than traditional citation-based measures when applied to scientific abstracts.

results.baseline: Static LDA applied to the same time windows, providing a reference point for topic stability and detection capability.
results.success_criteria: If the temporal models show significantly shorter lead times and higher precision/recall in detecting interdisciplinary topics compared to LDA, the hypothesis is supported. If not, the hypothesis is refuted.
